title: eludite.agents.start, prompt and cancel output
description: The Agents window's agent and session state.

state.description: `stopped`: no session; `starting`: spawning, initialize or session/new in flight; `ready`: waiting for a prompt; `needs_login`: the agent reported no login (see `login`); `running`: a turn is in progress; `error`: the agent failed or exited (see `message`).

generation.description: The session generation: it grows on every start or restart. Events of an older generation are dropped.

session_id.description: The ACP session id, once session/new answered.

agent_info.description: The agent's own name and version from ACP initialize (`agentInfo`).

message.description: Why the agent is in `error`, or what it is doing.

login.description: In `needs_login`: the agent's login methods, each with the command to run in a terminal.

command.description: The command line to run in a terminal.

source.description: `native`: the eludite-claude-acp adapter (beside the executable, ELUDITE_CLAUDE_ACP or PATH); `npx`: the Node adapter; `settings`: added by the user in agents.json.

pending_permissions.description: Permission requests waiting for an answer (eludite.agents.permission).

commands.description: The agent's slash commands, from its latest ACP `available_commands_update` (a new list replaces the old one), as the Agents window's slash-command menu offers them. Empty until the agent sends a list, and for an agent that has none. A prompt starting with `/name` runs one; it is text the agent receives.

name.description: The command's name, without the leading `/`.

hint.description: What the command takes after its name (ACP's `input.hint`), when it takes input.
